note: `reached` is `No_n_n_cell > 0`, the very quantity this pass increases, so a placed segment makes every row in its airport 10-minute cell a candidate to flip from unreached to reached. Each placed segment's cell is drawn in proportion to that airport-month's departure traffic and this lane's unreached rows there are counted. It is an UPPER estimate: one cell may take several placed segments, and a flip also needs the placed segment's clock to survive into the neighbourhood aggregate. The timestamps are datetime64[us]; converting them with //10**9 collapses a month into ten cells and was the first version's error.

answers_to_reach_spec_section_7.1_match_mode: this lane's block never reads match_mode -- it reads MVT_ID_mvt, airport, day, stand_lat, stand_lon, obs_has_clock, obs_offblock, obs_matched, reach_class and ev_key, and nothing else. A mode of 3 is IGNORED, not treated as a wide match. reach_class is passed through to counts and never branched on, so a new value is safe.
answers_to_reach_spec_section_7.2_contested_served_bytes: NOT all clear. Some of the 9,875 are rows this lane MOVES today: the placed counts at this lane's served airports are EDDF 4,267 and LEMD 976, an upper bound of 5,243 rows that carry this lane's v17 correction and would become surfacefit's. That is not a double write -- the class vector is one boundary -- but a row that leaves this lane's class and is NOT then written by surfacefit keeps this lane's v17 value as an ORPHAN. The composition after the handshake has to name who writes them.
answers_to_reach_spec_section_7.3_census: this lane's per-airport-month class census is consistent with section 4's airport-months; the placed counts themselves cannot be reproduced here, because the segments are surfacefit's side of the block.
answers_to_reach_spec_section_7.4_spillover: MEASURED, and it is the largest effect on this side. `reached` is `No_n_n_cell > 0` -- the quantity this pass increases -- so the pass moves the reach GRAIN and not only the class boundary. Upper estimate ~19,704 rows flip unreached -> reached across the two ranking months, of which ~15,744 at LFPG (both cells held, no served byte), ~3,199 at EDDF and ~286 at LEMD -- i.e. up to ~3,485 rows would ENTER cells this lane already serves, from a cell the hold holds, without ever having been priced there. At EDDF july the estimate is 2,272 of 2,384 unreached rows, so `EDDF/unreached` largely dissolves into the served `EDDF/reached`.

asymmetry_worth_stating: a false match costs the two lanes differently. Surfacefit reads the row's OWN clock, so a wrong placement damages that one row. This lane reads the NEIGHBOURS' clocks, so a wrong placement enters an aggregate that every row in the cell reads -- about 5 rows per 10-minute cell at these airports. Gate (c), the one-day time-shift placebo, is therefore load-bearing for this lane in a way it is not for the other, and gate (b)'s density-scaled bound should be read as a bound on POLLUTED CELLS, not on damaged rows.
